loci.reading: Two graphically preserved hooked marks below the initial and beginning of the surname
loci.evidence: The crop shows two separate short marks, each with a broad upper portion and a descending leftward stem. Their count and geometry are clear; their textual function remains open.

The initial has two long limbs and a short crossbar. A clear gap precedes the surname; the intervening gap contains no separate full stop. The surname’s returning connected strokes support Grothendieck.
The final point is detached by a clear character-like gap after the final accented e. The long descending cancellation curve passes immediately to its right.
